sloka: स त्वं सुपुष्टमाहारैः स्वशरीरमनुत्तमम् ।भक्षयित्वामृतरसं तेन तृप्तिर्भविष्यति ।। ७.७८.१८ ॥
transliteration: sa tvaṁ supuṣṭamāhāraiḥ svaśarīramanuttamam ।bhakṣayitvāmṛtarasaṁ tena tṛptirbhaviṣyati ।। 7.78.18 ॥

translations.english: You, having eaten the nectar-like essence of your own excellent body, which was well-nourished with food, will then find satisfaction.
